sections.h2: Business Website Design Cost in Kerala

rows.service: Starter — a one to three page responsive site with a contact form and Google Maps integration, suited to solo businesses and local shops
Standard — five to ten pages, SEO setup, blog, WhatsApp click to chat, and enquiry forms, the most common choice for Kerala SMEs
Advanced — custom UI design, Malayalam plus English content, booking systems, and advanced technical SEO

sections.note: Every tier includes mobile responsive design, SSL setup, and basic on-page SEO by default, never billed as an add-on. Figures are the bands published on our Website Design and Development page — one source of truth across the site.

sections.intro: The Website Design Cost in Kerala for online stores and WordPress builds follows the same tiered approach. Ecommerce Website Cost Kerala starts with a small store tier for up to fifty products, WooCommerce or Shopify setup, and Razorpay or PayU integration, moves up through a growing store tier with category filters and shipping integrations, and a custom platform tier for multi-vendor marketplaces. WordPress Website Cost Kerala runs from template-based sites through semi-custom builds to fully custom themes.

sections.h2: What Drives The Website Design Cost in Kerala Up Or Down

paragraphs.text: The Website Design Cost in Kerala moves for a few clear reasons. Custom UI and UX design, bilingual content, payment gateway integration, and third-party API connections typically move a project toward the higher end of its tier.
Using a strong template, providing your own copy and images, or launching in phases can bring the Website Design Cost in Kerala down without cutting corners on quality.
Domain registration, hosting, SSL renewal, and premium plugins are recurring costs most Website Design Cost in Kerala quotes leave out.
Teknoppy lists every recurring cost upfront in every proposal, not as a footnote after the contract is signed.

items.q: What is the average Website Design Cost in Kerala for a small business?
items.a: Most small business websites fall in the Standard tier, covering five to ten pages with SEO setup and basic functionality.

items.q: Is Website Design Cost in Kerala a one time payment or recurring?
items.a: Development is a one time cost. Hosting, domain renewal, and any maintenance plan are separate recurring costs, listed upfront in every proposal.

devNotes.pricingDeviation: DECISION FOR THE CLIENT. The source doc writes every tier as 'price on request', and its closing note explains why: 'real pillar-page pricing is needed before this goes live.' That pricing does exist — the Web Design, WordPress and Ecommerce pillars have published bands since the pillar build — and the same doc states these figures 'match what is published on our WordPress Development and Ecommerce Development pillar pages exactly, one source of truth across the site.' A pricing page that answers 'price on request' in every row also contradicts its own hero copy ('Teknoppy publishes real tiered pricing below'). So the published bands are used here instead of the placeholder. To revert, replace each `price` with 'Price on request'.
devNotes.pricingMapping: Business tiers map to web-design.json's table: Starter → 'Landing Page (1–3 pages)' Rs. 15,000–40,000; Standard → 'Basic Business Website (5–8 pages)' Rs. 25,000–50,000; Advanced → 'Professional Multi-Page Website (10–20 pages)' Rs. 50,000–1,20,000. The doc's Standard tier is '5 to 10 pages', which straddles the pillar's 5–8 and 10–20 bands, and its Advanced tier (custom UI, bilingual, booking systems) could equally be read as the pillar's 'Corporate Website with CMS' band at Rs. 1,20,000–3,00,000. Those two rows are the ones to check. Ecommerce and WordPress rows map one-to-one onto ecommerce.json and wordpress.json with no interpretation.
